verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a documentation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows ReadMe as a hosted SaaS. Custom domains (CNAME/SSL), exporting docs and Git sync are adjacent features, not running the core product on your own infrastructure, and no evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
